title: TurkBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Turkish Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Multiple-choice stereotype association tests using ambiguous and disambiguated contexts to measure reliance on age-related stereotypes, adapted from the BBQ (Bias Benchmark for QA) framework.

Evaluated through a Toxicity Detection task using an LLM-as-a-Judge approach to measure cultural sensitivity, awareness, and the avoidance of offensive or dismissive content regarding cultural differences within Turkish society.
Assessed via multiple-choice questions testing stereotype reliance (BBQ framework) and evaluated through LLM-as-a-Judge toxicity metrics checking for the perpetuation of gender-based stereotypes.
